title: Project Corvus — Virtual data room index (v4.2)
text:
PROJECT CORVUS — VIRTUAL DATA ROOM INDEX
HELLEBORE PRECISION NV
Index version 4.2 — status as at 11 September 2026 — STRICTLY CONFIDENTIAL

Vendor: Ardenne Capital Partners SRL ("ACP" or the "Vendor")
Target: Hellebore Precision NV ("HPN" or the "Target"), registered office at the leased premises listed under 8.1
Vendor's counsel: Dewulf Vandersmissen BV, Boulevard de Waterloo 34, 1000 Brussels
Contact partner: Ms. Céline Dewulf — c.dewulf@dewulf-vandersmissen.example.be — +32 2 555 01 23
VDR Administrator: Tomas Reyniers — vdr.corvus@dewulf-vandersmissen.example.be — +32 470 12 34 56
VDR platform: vdr.dewulf-vandersmissen.example.be (access by invitation only)
Our ref: DV-2026-CORVUS-01
Q&A: questions are to be submitted through the Corvus Q&A module only; no direct contact with management.

Access levels: L1 (all bidders), L2 (Phase 2 bidders), CT (clean team only). Documents marked "(redacted)" are available unredacted at level CT after signature of the clean team protocol (document 0.2).

0. GENERAL

1.4 Conflict-of-interest declarations under Article 7:96 of the Belgian Companies and Associations Code — 2024, 2025 — L2
1.5 Statutory auditor's reports, financial years 2023 to 2025 — L1

2. FINANCING

2.2 Amendment and waiver letter (change of control) — 30 June 2026 — v2 — L2
2.3 Escrow account details: BE72 7340 8812 5507, held with KBC in the name of ACP — L2 (signatory list: CT)

3. MATERIAL CONTRACTS

4. LITIGATION
4.1 Claim by Mr. Joris Lambrechts (former commercial agent) against HPN before the Brussels Enterprise Court — writ of summons served 19 April 2024 — docket A/24/03117 — L2
4.2 Lambrechts: submissions of the Target of 15 October 2024 and 12 March 2025 — internal file HPN-LIT-2024-002 — L2
4.3 Litigation summary and provisioning memorandum — 5 September 2026 — L2
4.4 Confirmation letter: no other pending or threatened proceedings — signed by Mr. Verhoeven — 1 September 2026 — L1

5. REGULATORY

5.2 Pre-notification contact with the European Commission (Directorate-General for Competition) under the EU Merger Regulation — briefing paper — 2 April 2026 — L2 (redacted: market share data, CT)
5.3 Records of processing activities under Article 30 GDPR — group-wide — 2026 — L1
5.4 Environmental permit, production site — issued 2019, valid until 2039 — L1

6. EMPLOYMENT
6.1 Service agreement of Mr. Anselm Verhoeven, CEO — 1 September 2021, amended 15 December 2024 (change-of-control bonus) — L2 (redacted: remuneration, CT)
6.2 Employment agreement of Katrien Maes, CFO — 4 January 2022 — L2 (redacted: remuneration, CT)
6.3 Collective bargaining agreements applicable at the Ghent site — L1
6.4 Long-term incentive plan rules and grant letters to Mr. Verhoeven and K. Maes — CT

7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
7.1 Domain names: hellebore-precision.example.com, hellebore.example.be, hpn-parts.example.eu — registrant confirmations — L1

8. REAL ESTATE
8.1 Lease of premises at Industrieweg 112, 9000 Ghent — landlord Immo Scheldekaai NV — 1 April 2018, nine-year term, renewal option 2027 — L1

Index notes
Version history: v4.0 (28 August 2026); v4.1 (4 September 2026: folders 4 and 5 added); v4.2 (11 September 2026: documents 2.2, 3.4 and 6.4 added; 3.3 moved to CT).
This index is issued by the Vendor's counsel for the sole purpose of Project Corvus and does not constitute a representation as to completeness. Questions on access rights go to the VDR Administrator; questions on content go through the Q&A module.
notes: Virtual data room index for an invented Belgian M&A sale process. SHOULD redact: the codename (PROJECT CORVUS in the header, Project Corvus in the closing note, bare Corvus twice), the target in its all-caps header line and normal form, its defined acronym (HPN), its Dutch subsidiary and the word mark HELLEBORE, the vendor and its defined acronym (ACP), vendor's counsel firm + street address + postal code and city, the contact partner (full name, later Ms. Dewulf), the VDR administrator, both example.* emails, both phones, the escrow IBAN, the bank named only by acronym (KBC, twice), the auditor, supplier, distributor and landlord, the claimant (full name, then bare surname Lambrechts), the CEO (full name, later Mr. Verhoeven twice) and CFO (full name, then K. Maes), the firm's matter reference, the Enterprise Court docket, the internal litigation file number, the VDR host name and the three bare domain names, the leased premises (street + postal code and city), bare Ghent (site) and Eindhoven. SHOULD NOT redact: Belgian Competition Authority, European Commission, Directorate-General for Competition, EU Merger Regulation, Brussels Enterprise Court (including the word Brussels inside it), Belgian Companies and Associations Code and Article 7:96, Article 30 GDPR, Benelux Office for Intellectual Property, EUIPO; role labels (the Vendor, the Target, bidders, management, VDR Administrator, Vendor's counsel, clean team, top-three customer); access-level codes L1/L2/CT, version numbers, dates, amounts, the trade mark registration number, folder and document numbers.
